```sql
WITH fo AS (
  SELECT o.id
    FROM orders o
   WHERE o.tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s
     AND o.created_at >= %(from)s
     AND o.created_at <  %(to)s
     AND o.status IN ('paid', 'processing', 'shipped', 'delivered')
),
lines AS (
  SELECT pv.product_id, pv.id AS variant_id, ol.order_id, ol.quantity, ol.line_total_cents
    FROM order_lines ol
    JOIN fo ON fo.id = ol.order_id
    JOIN product_variants pv ON pv.id = ol.variant_id::uuid
),
per_order AS (
  SELECT product_id, order_id,
         sum(quantity)          AS quantity,
         sum(line_total_cents)  AS revenue_cents
    FROM lines
   GROUP BY product_id, order_id
),
per_product AS (
  SELECT product_id,
         count(*)                AS order_count,
         sum(quantity)::bigint   AS quantity,
         sum(revenue_cents)      AS revenue_cents
    FROM per_order
   GROUP BY product_id
),
variants AS (
  SELECT product_id, count(*) AS variant_count
    FROM (SELECT DISTINCT product_id, variant_id FROM lines) v
   GROUP BY product_id
)
SELECT p.id,
       p.sku,
       p.name,
       p.brand,
       p.currency,
       pp.order_count,
       pp.quantity,
       pp.revenue_cents,
       v.variant_count
  FROM per_product pp
  JOIN variants v ON v.product_id = pp.product_id
  JOIN products p ON p.id = pp.product_id
 ORDER BY pp.quantity DESC, pp.revenue_cents DESC
 LIMIT %(limit)s
```

De `count(DISTINCT o.id)` op de grote set regels, die een externe sort op uuid veroorzaakte, is vervangen door een groepering per (product, order), waarna `count(*)` de distincte orders geeft. `GROUP BY` is teruggebracht tot `p.id` omdat dat de primary key is, en de bigint-types van de kolommen blijven gelijk aan het origineel. Bij gelijke `quantity` en `revenue_cents` is de volgorde net als in het origineel niet gegarandeerd, omdat de ORDER BY daar geen tiebreaker heeft.
